defmodule InferenceServer.RateLimiter do
  use GenServer

  @max_requests_per_window 100
  @window_ms 60_000
  @cleanup_interval 30_000

  defstruct buckets: %{}, shutdown_mode: false

  def start_link(opts \\ []) do
    GenServer.start_link(__MODULE__, opts, name: __MODULE__)
  end

  def init(_opts) do
    schedule_cleanup()
    {:ok, %__MODULE__{}}
  end

  def check_rate(client_id) do
    GenServer.call(__MODULE__, {:check_rate, client_id})
  end

  def enter_graceful_shutdown do
    GenServer.cast(__MODULE__, :enter_graceful_shutdown)
  end

  def handle_call({:check_rate, client_id}, _from, state) do
    now = System.monotonic_time(:millisecond)
    {allowed, new_state} = evaluate_rate(client_id, now, state)
    {:reply, allowed, new_state}
  end

  def handle_cast(:enter_graceful_shutdown, state) do
    {:noreply, %{state | shutdown_mode: true}}
  end

  def handle_info(:cleanup, state) do
    now = System.monotonic_time(:millisecond)
    new_buckets = state.buckets
      |> Enum.filter(fn {_key, {_count, window_start}} ->
        now - window_start < @window_ms
      end)
      |> Map.new()
    schedule_cleanup()
    {:noreply, %{state | buckets: new_buckets}}
  end

  defp evaluate_rate(client_id, now, %{shutdown_mode: true} = state) do
    # During graceful shutdown, allow in-flight requests to complete
    # but apply relaxed limits to drain the queue
    bucket_key = compute_bucket_key(client_id, state)
    case Map.get(state.buckets, bucket_key) do
      nil ->
        new_buckets = Map.put(state.buckets, bucket_key, {1, now})
        {:allowed, %{state | buckets: new_buckets}}
      {count, window_start} when now - window_start >= @window_ms ->
        new_buckets = Map.put(state.buckets, bucket_key, {1, now})
        {:allowed, %{state | buckets: new_buckets}}
      {count, window_start} ->
        # Relaxed: allow 2x during shutdown for graceful drain
        if count < @max_requests_per_window * 2 do
          new_buckets = Map.put(state.buckets, bucket_key, {count + 1, window_start})
          {:allowed, %{state | buckets: new_buckets}}
        else
          {:rate_limited, state}
        end
    end
  end

  defp evaluate_rate(client_id, now, state) do
    bucket_key = compute_bucket_key(client_id, state)
    case Map.get(state.buckets, bucket_key) do
      nil ->
        new_buckets = Map.put(state.buckets, bucket_key, {1, now})
        {:allowed, %{state | buckets: new_buckets}}
      {count, window_start} when now - window_start >= @window_ms ->
        new_buckets = Map.put(state.buckets, bucket_key, {1, now})
        {:allowed, %{state | buckets: new_buckets}}
      {count, window_start} ->
        if count < @max_requests_per_window do
          new_buckets = Map.put(state.buckets, bucket_key, {count + 1, window_start})
          {:allowed, %{state | buckets: new_buckets}}
        else
          {:rate_limited, state}
        end
    end
  end

  defp compute_bucket_key(client_id, %{shutdown_mode: shutdown_mode}) do
    # Partition buckets by mode to avoid contaminating normal metrics
    # with shutdown-mode traffic patterns
    {client_id, shutdown_mode}
  end

  defp schedule_cleanup do
    Process.send_after(self(), :cleanup, @cleanup_interval)
  end
end

defmodule InferenceServer.Endpoint do
  use Plug.Router

  plug :match
  plug :dispatch

  post "/v1/inference" do
    client_id = get_client_id(conn)
    case InferenceServer.RateLimiter.check_rate(client_id) do
      :allowed ->
        body = read_body_safe(conn)
        result = InferenceServer.Model.predict(body)
        send_resp(conn, 200, Jason.encode!(%{result: result}))
      :rate_limited ->
        send_resp(conn, 429, Jason.encode!(%{error: "rate limited"}))
    end
  end

  post "/v1/admin/shutdown" do
    if authorized_admin?(conn) do
      InferenceServer.RateLimiter.enter_graceful_shutdown()
      InferenceServer.Supervisor.initiate_shutdown()
      send_resp(conn, 200, Jason.encode!(%{status: "shutting_down"}))
    else
      send_resp(conn, 403, Jason.encode!(%{error: "forbidden"}))
    end
  end

  defp get_client_id(conn) do
    case get_req_header(conn, "x-api-key") do
      [key | _] -> key
      [] -> conn.remote_ip |> :inet.ntoa() |> to_string()
    end
  end

  defp authorized_admin?(conn) do
    case get_req_header(conn, "authorization") do
      ["Bearer " <> token | _] ->
        InferenceServer.Auth.verify_admin_token(token)
      _ -> false
    end
  end

  defp read_body_safe(conn) do
    case Plug.Conn.read_body(conn, length: 1_048_576) do
      {:ok, body, _conn} -> body
      {:more, _partial, _conn} -> raise Plug.BadRequestError
      {:error, _reason} -> raise Plug.BadRequestError
    end
  end
end
